method.target: M-release sign of original full-census shared-reference EOG positive-pairwise 90th-percentile span
method.measurement: entire A/B/M triple at distinct physical grid sites
method.error: at most one site-wide arbitrary corrupted triple; same-site repetition provides no independent correction
method.optimality: globally optimal minimum number of distinct equal-cost sites for a nonadaptive whole-profile panel via exact binary SciPy MILP
method.independent_verification: every candidate true mask and every single-site arbitrary three-bit corruption enumerated in independent decoder
method.structural_impossibility: at least one opposite-sign pair differs in fewer than three distinct grid sites; cannot correct one adversarial site error using existing complete-site observations
method.source_original: same 12x64 original worlds and current-D one-missed-G observation fibre equivalence classes

strict_limits: All counts are constructed finite-world arithmetic and not natural ecological prevalence or independent experimental replicates.
One geographic site can be fully systematically wrong; does not model correlated bias affecting several sites.
All A/B/M constraint bits at each selected site are assumed directly measurable, at equal cost and jointly.
At most one occupied G cell undetected in otherwise fully known correct G; no probabilistic detection or survey effort.
Nonadaptive exact site selection; not an adaptive plan or guarantee of field visit count.
No inference of causal dispersal, climate niches, or physiological tolerance, and no fourth EOG-WF endpoint.
